author: locman1
body:
I locman1 solemnly swear that on the 7th of August 2015 did not mean to fly hack, I had my hacked client because I was doing something else with a friend on a different server and forgot I had it on and accidentally pressed F which activates fly.
So please give me a second chance and please you won't regret it.

Sincerely, Locman1

title: Appealing a Infraction

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You were fly hacking, and regardless of the fact that it was a simple mistake, according to you, you still caused trouble to the server. You will not be appealed.

Regards,
PelThePenguin.
